tools.name: get_arc_network_info
tools.title: Get Arc Testnet network info
tools.description: Return Arc Testnet connection parameters: chain ID, RPC URL, block explorer, native gas token (USDC), and faucet guidance. Use this whenever a caller asks how to connect a wallet or client to Arc Testnet.

tools.name: get_arc_knowledge
tools.title: Get Arc docs knowledge base
tools.description: Return the ArcPilot condensed Arc documentation (network overview, App Kit features, agentic economy protocols ERC-8004/ERC-8183, and developer references). Optionally filter to sections whose headings contain a query string.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter section headings.

tools.name: get_address_balance
tools.title: Get address balance on Arc Testnet
tools.description: Return the native USDC (gas token) balance on Arc Testnet for a given 0x address. Read-only, no signing. Uses the public Arc Testnet RPC.

address.description: EVM address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars) to query on Arc Testnet.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.title: Get Arc Testnet transaction
tools.description: Fetch a transaction and its receipt from Arc Testnet by hash. Returns from/to, value in USDC, status, block, and gas used. Read-only.

hash.description: Transaction hash (0x-prefixed, 66 chars) on Arc Testnet.

tools.name: get_explorer_url
tools.title: Build Arc Testnet explorer URL
tools.description: Build a canonical Arc Testnet block explorer URL for an address, transaction hash, or block number.

value.description: The address, tx hash, or block number.
